name: Reward-based recall: one continuing Brain.live life paid at the query, with the write into the working trace as an action of the basal ganglia
question: Can one continuing Brain.compose life, paid only for the right answer at the query, keep a cue through neutral events and a distractor and let a replacement in, through its working trace; and does a learned write/hold choice of the same actor do what the founder's fixed write cannot?
conditions_note: finite_horizon_inputs.TRAIN_CONDITIONS by name: the recall/2 set with the distractor at delays one and two, the replacement and the order gates; episodes are interleaved uniformly at random
pay_note: delivered with the first observation of the next episode and done=True, so the library's own boundary rule resets the stream's trace; the action that call issues is the world's throwaway at START

fixed.note: the founder's law: the trace is written after every event

gated.note: a second motor slot of two choices, hold or write; after a hold the instrument restores the trace, its last activation and its cold flag to their values before the moment, which equals skipping the founder's write; the choice is sampled and credited by the same actor and the same reward

composed.note: the 0.83.0 composition of the trace (amplitude 3.0, scale 1.2, retention 0) and of the actor-critic; arousal on; no episodic memory

recall5.note: recall/5's declared trace genes at the composition of releases before 0.82.0; the actor-critic at the 0.83.0 composition

credit.note: the composed trace with the key-door nursery's delayed-credit actor point (lam 0.95, gamma 0.95, critic rate 5)

controls.random: uniform over the two answers at the query (expected 0.5)
controls.frozen: every arm's reading at zero training episodes, the newborn
controls.history: a tabular learner given the asked value at the query (alpha 0.1, epsilon 0.1), the external-history control; it must be competent for the chamber to count

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start; erased clears the trace before the query, reset clears the transient neural state and the trace

gates.statement: development reading only: horizon = the largest contiguous passed prefix of clean-0, clean-1, clean-2 at the greedy floor; closure = horizon at least 2 with distractor-1, replacement-1 and order-latest-1 at the floor, erased and reset at or below lesion with intact at least lesion_margin above them on every condition of delay above zero, and the history control at or above its floor; the founder with the fixed write is the mechanism's control

seeds.confirmation_note: unopened until the instrument, protocol digest, genes and gates are frozen

arousal_note: every recipe sets the body's need to 0.2 reward per moment, 0.9 of what a life that always answers right earns (pay 1 at the query of an episode of 4.6 moments on average over the conditions; the chain nursery's need_share), and a youth of 300 moments; the other arousal genes are the founders. With the founder need of 0 the brain habituates to pay it cannot predict, stays calm on nine moments of ten and learns from few outcomes (development reading of 14 October)
